clips.title: The story
paras: Following the creation of specialized armor, the dwarven smith Furen Longbeard sends a copy of his findings across the district to Grimand Elmore. The brief errand carries technical notes between two headstrong weaponsmiths sharing space in Stormwind City.

Having forged the specialized Fire Hardened Mail, Furen Longbeard documents the intricate heat-treating techniques and elemental principles he uncovered during the process. Rather than keeping the knowledge entirely to himself, he commits the notes to parchment and tasks an adventurer with delivering them straight to Grimand Elmore, a seasoned crafter operating out of a nearby weapon shop.

Grimand Elmore's immediate reaction upon receiving the manuscript is wounded pride. Adamant that he taught Furen everything the younger dwarf knows, Grimand bristles at the notion that his former pupil could offer him instruction. Despite his outward indignation, the craftsman cannot resist perusing the text, quickly finding an intriguing idea hidden within the notes that he is eager to test for himself.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I made a copy of my notes on the techniques I learned while making your armor, and I need them sent to Grimand Elmore. He's here in the Dwarven District, in the weapon shop.
And duck when you give these to him. He's fiercely proud of his skills, and won't like the idea of learning something from me...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hello, and well met. How might I be of service to you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Furen wrote this? How dare he! Why, I taught him everything he knows! To think he could teach me something is outrageous! Outrageous!
Hm... But there is something in his notes that I'd like to try...
